observed_change_definition: First E7/E11 edge deterioration versus dispatch snapshot: newly blocked, newly non-finite, or travel-time increase at least max(5 s, 15%). This labels observations and does not change the existing decision policy.
interpretation_rule: Repeated multi-replan evidence requires auditable two-or-more applied replans in at least two seeds and at least two demand profiles. Otherwise implementation demonstration only. This fixed synthetic scenario alone is not classified as strong evidence; timing/topology sensitivity remains untested.
